subject: Bi-Weekly Meeting Schedule and Rules Reform
overview: The committee debated shifting from weekly to bi-weekly regular meetings to prioritize subcommittee work. They voted to report the rules updates to the full council, including provisions for virtual participation and year-round bi-weekly scheduling.

items.title: Proposed City Council Rules Updates
items.summary: Vice President Zac Bears presented draft language for bi-weekly meetings, virtual participation options, and the online posting of meeting materials beginning in September.

items.title: Councilor Salary Amendment
items.summary: The committee rejected an amendment to reduce council salaries by 50% if the meeting frequency were reduced.

items.title: Summer Meeting Schedule Amendment
items.summary: Approved an amendment to maintain the bi-weekly meeting frequency throughout July and August rather than reducing to once per month.

items.title: Public Comment on Rules Changes
items.summary: Residents and councilors debated whether a reduced meeting schedule would hinder public transparency or enhance legislative productivity through subcommittees.

items.title: Final Recommendation
items.summary: Referred the proposed rules updates to the full City Council for approval as amended.
